text:
alice: Noticed a PP bubble regression after yesterday's kernel push (kernel_v2). On 16xA100 microbatch=8 the per-step jitter jumped ~22% and throughput dipped.
ben: Same here on an 8-GPU smoke. Spike centers on the first all-reduce in the forward pass. Do we have a profile dump?
alice: Pasted a trimmed flame: `flame: kernel_v2:allreduce: 44ms | kvcache_lookup: 9ms | forward: 30ms` 5 the comm peak aligns with the 1F1B fence.
dmitri: Share perf counters? Want NVLink vs PCIe breakdown.
alice: nvprof snippet: `GPU0 allreduce 43.7ms (NVLink) ; idle_gap 11.9ms ; kvcache_refill 9.3ms` 5 looks like extra idle between kernels.
carla: Did kernel_v2 change prefetch/allocation behavior?
alice: It introduced lane-prefetch which reallocates some pinned buffers earlier. That might increase KV churn under interleaved microbatches.
eva: Observed pattern: with 1F1B + microbatch=8 we get repeated kvcache misses at stage handoffs. Switching microbatch=4 drops misses ~70% but increases per-token compute.
ben: Two quick experiments: A) disable lane-prefetch in v2; B) sweep microbatch [2,4,8] while prober bumps parallelism so throughput target holds. Need metrics: avg step latency, allreduce wall, kvcache_miss_rate.
alice: Launching A on staging (16xA100, 1F1B, microbatch=8, lane-prefetch OFF). Early: allreduce ~35ms, kvcache misses down ~60%, 95th tail down ~14%.
dmitri: Can you paste NCCL trace? I want to see segmentation/overlap.
alice: ```nccl_trace:
[0] reduce_scatter start 12.0ms
[1] allreduce start 22.6ms
overlap compute window 6.3ms
wait 6.1ms
``` 5 overlap window tiny.
carla: That suggests compute/comm overlap is getting broken. Maybe lane-prefetch inserts long memory ops that preempt compute kernels and force the rendezvous to block.
eva: Also saw a subtle tokenizer change earlier this week bumped avg seq len 192->206. Padding added ~3% compute per microbatch. Chaining effects.
ben: So combined: +3% compute from padding + prefetch stalls => allreduce can't fully hide and bubble expands. We should treat it as cross-layer interaction.
carla: Proposed plan:
1) Roll back lane-prefetch to canary ASAP.
2) Run microbatch sweep [2,4,8] with NVProf traces per-stage.
3) Try increasing kvcache LRU threshold by 1 to reduce eviction storms.
4) Experiment with microbatch interleaving order tweaks to improve locality.
eva: Customers on Dedicated could be impacted. Need fast telemetry and a hotfix path.
alice: Rolling back lane-prefetch to canary now (hotfix queued). Microbatch sweep scheduled in ~30m. LRU-tweak PR opened: runtime#6789.
ben: Add lightweight console metrics: per-stage kvcache_miss_rate and allreduce_wait_ms so we can monitor canary.
dmitri: I'll wire traces into observability and set alert at +15% over baseline.
carla: Also note kernel_v2 prefetch behavior in the release notes and call out PP caveats for devex docs.
alice: Done in the release PR, pinged @devex. Also adding canary dashboard widgets.
eva: If rollback fixes canary, let's rework prefetch: keep benefits for single-GPU paths but gate or adapt it for PP schedules.
ben: Long term: smarter prefetch that respects microbatch interleaving + adaptive kvcache heuristics to avoid eviction storms.
dmitri: Final canary numbers (post-rollback): microbatch=8 avg step 53ms (-11%), 95th 77ms (-16%), stage-2 kvcache_miss_rate 0.038 -> 0.014.
carla: Good signal. Proceed with rollback, monitor for regressions, and add follow-up tickets for a gated prefetch and kvcache tuning.
ben: Thanks all, big win for infra ops :raised_hands:
